snippet.title: Nivalis Nights - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1488490/Nivalis_Nights/

A gameplay trailer for Nivalis Nights. Grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in a cyberpunk city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds. 
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
